items.mainDefect: The `queued` default `timezone.now()` runs only once, at import time, so every AssignmentSource instance gets the same stale timestamp.

secondary.defect: The test only checks that `queued` is not None, so it would not catch the stale-timestamp bug.

items.mainDefect: The `queued` default `timezone.now()` runs only once, at module import, so every AssignmentSource instance shares the process start time.

secondary.defect: `to_dict()` returns a datetime, which would break if the Celery serializer were switched from pickle to JSON.
